description:
Move environment variables to the global scope
Add a better check for vectorstore existence
Introduced a new function for better readability
Co-authored-by: Pulp <51127079+PulpCattel@users.noreply.github.com>

Recreating the PR https://github.com/imartinez/privateGPT/pull/201 due to the history getting way too messy (my frustration was beyond imagination...). Sorry for the inconvenience.

comments.body: load_dotenv() is called in line 55 too. We should remove one of the two
instead of hardcoded 500, you could use the chunk_size variable
This implementation is quite fragile, as @PulpCattel pointed out. It may break with a new version of Chroma.
What would be your suggeson for foolproofing the check for an existing index?

@PulpCattel suggested checking if persist_directory is empty or not, but in my experience when ingest fails the directory contains 2 documents... so I can't think of a much better solution. Maybe using > 3 instead of == 4 makes it a little more flexible. But I don't love that solution either, so I'd be happy to go with this for the moment

Yeah I think for now this can be a workable compromise.
If we keep this, a couple of small fixes:
* The second `if` from the top is over-indented.
* The two `path.join()` could become `path.join(persist_directory, 'index', '*.bin')`, i.e. split `'index/*.bin'` and `'index/*.pkl'`
